concept_a: Checking your phone at supermarket checkout
title_hook: Why We Pull Out Our Phone at Checkout
teaser: Your brain hates tiny moments of nothingness. Silence feels uncomfortable, so it fills it automatically.

title_hook: How Places Silently Change Your Behavior
teaser: We don't become quiet because of libraries. Libraries make us quiet. Places silently shape behavior.

title_hook: The Songs We Can't Listen to Anymore
teaser: We don't remember songs. We remember who we were when we heard them. Songs become emotional bookmarks.

title_hook: Why We Never Close Open Browser Tabs
teaser: You're not saving information. You're saving possibilities... a future version of yourself.

title_hook: The Real Reason You Check the Lock Twice
teaser: You're not checking the lock. You're checking whether you can trust your own memory.
